title: Russian Pilaf with Tomatoes
description: A traditional Russian dish made with pilaf, tomatoes, and a hint of Russian flavors. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the pilaf and stir to coat with the oil and tomato mixture.
Add the salt, pepper, and water to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low.
Cover the saucepan and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the pilaf is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
